summary: Phase 2 backend testing: 15/15 pytest tests pass on new endpoints (uploads + files fetch, loan lifecycle apply→approve→disburse→partial+full repay, credit score 300-850 with signals, loan reject flow, loans RBAC, notifications list/mark/mark-all, analytics prices/demand/weather, 20 video templates, signup farm_size+referral, end-to-end referral bonus ₦5,000 credited to BOTH referrer + referred buyer on first completed order with ledger 'referral_bonus' entries and notifications). Frontend verified: /signup renders farm_size (hectares) + Referral code (optional) fields correctly. Login/dashboard flows from iteration 1 remain valid — not re-tested in depth since Phase 1 was already at 100% and backend fully validates the new logic.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1700 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (/routes/loans.py, /routes/notifications.py, /routes/uploads.py, /routes/analytics.py) before Phase 3. Becoming hard to navigate.

loan repay schedule marking logic (line ~1450): subtracts row.amount from remaining without checking if row amount > remaining, so a row can be marked 'paid' on a partial payment. Minor: UI will show the row paid even though underpaid. Consider tracking paid_amount per row.

Referral eligibility uses `completed_count == 1` after status is already set to 'completed' in DB — this is fine, but it also assumes confirm_delivery is the only path to 'completed'. Dispute resolve (release_to_farmer / split) also sets status='completed' and would NOT trigger the referral bonus. Intentional? If so, document; if not, extract into helper.
put_object / get_object use synchronous `requests` inside async endpoints. Under load this blocks the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or running in threadpool.

/api/files/{path:path} is public (no auth). Acceptable for listing images, but any authenticated user could discover another user's uploaded KYC/PDF if they guess the path. Paths use UUID so enumeration is hard, but consider signed URLs or owner checks for sensitive types (pdf).
compute_credit_score: `score += min(gmv / 1000_000, 5) * 10` adds at most 50 — comment in code says '+50 per NGN 1M, max 50' which is misleading (it's +10 per NGN 1M, max 50). Tweak comment.
Video templates are a hardcoded Python constant. Fine for MVP but consider moving to DB so ops can edit without redeploy.

success_rate.frontend: Phase 1 regression not re-run; Signup phase-2 fields verified visually

seed_data_creation: Backend self-seeds. Test created TEST_-prefixed users, 2 loans (1 approved+disbursed+repaid, 1 rejected), 1 referral-bonus end-to-end order, 1 uploaded image.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 pytest is /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py (15 tests). Referral bonus test creates fresh users each run — cumulative test data grows. Upload test hits real Emergent object storage (requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). If storage returns 503, check storage_key init. Frontend pages /app/farmer/loans, /app/farmer/videos, /app/admin/loans, /app/analytics + notifications bell were NOT exercised via Playwright this iteration due to a login-script timing issue — suggest main agent spot-check manually or next testing agent re-runs with a simpler demo-card click login. Backend logic fully covers the happy paths.
rca of the issue: N/A — all backend tests pass. Minor frontend coverage gap noted in context.
